title.zh: Thailand puts private wallets and offshore crypto transfers on notice in a major new crypto rule
title.en: Thailand puts private wallets and offshore crypto transfers on notice in a major new crypto rule

current_state.zh: Thailand's SEC will require supervised crypto platforms to collect and transmit sender and recipient information for coin transfers starting Feb. 27, 2027, with added verification for transfers above 30,000 baht involving self-hosted wallets.
current_state.en: Thailand's SEC will require supervised crypto platforms to collect and transmit sender and recipient information for coin transfers starting Feb. 27, 2027, with added verification for transfers above 30,000 baht involving self-hosted wallets.
